criteria.text: Every device in scope reports an agent, servers, branches and contractors included, checked against the inventory
criteria.how: Compare the inventory with the agents reporting at the end of week one, and list the gaps.

criteria.text: A ransomware simulation on one test machine is blocked or contained before it reaches a second machine
criteria.how: Run a harmless simulation on a test machine and watch whether it spreads.

criteria.text: A compromised machine is isolated in minutes, at any hour, by one action
criteria.how: Trigger a test alert out of hours and time it to the machine isolated.

criteria.text: A group in detect-only mode runs in prevention for two weeks without breaking its applications
criteria.how: Switch one group to prevention, and record what was blocked and what broke.

criteria.text: Every exclusion in scope has an owner and a reason, and the ones without are removed
criteria.how: Export the exclusions and review them with their owners.

readiness: The devices in scope listed, from the inventory the customer trusts
Test machines for the simulation, isolated from production
The detect-only group to switch, and its application owners told
Who answers an alert out of hours during the test
Security, legal and procurement steps known
